content.title: Professional Services & Implementation Capability
content.content:
SnapLogic's Professional Services organisation provides the delivery and enablement capability {{customer_name}} will require to deploy the platform, migrate existing pipelines, and enable the integration team. PS is a core part of the SnapLogic value proposition for complex enterprise deployments — not an afterthought.

[IMAGE:assets/images/customer/airbus_vendor_profile/Screenshot 2026-04-27 at 21.18.48.png:Professional Services and Implementation Capability]

**Team size**: 40+ PS consultants globally across AMER and EMEA

**Profiles**: Enterprise Architects, Senior Integration Consultants, Project Managers, Technical Trainers

**EMEA presence**: Consultants based in Germany, UK, Netherlands, France, Italy, Sweden — DACH delivery available in German

**Engagement models**: Time & Materials, Fixed-Deliverable Consulting, Managed Services (ongoing operational support)

**Partner ecosystem**: Large SI partners (Cognizant, Capgemini, Infosys, Wipro, TCS) and regional specialists (Blue Altair — 50+ SnapLogic-certified consultants) extend PS capacity for large-scale programmes

**Certifications**: SnapLogic Partner Certification Programme ensures consistent delivery quality across SI partners

[BOX:info]
**Prof. Services — confirm DACH PS resource availability for AH engagement**

Verify that SnapLogic Professional Services has German-speaking consultants available for Airbus Helicopters engagement delivery in DACH region.
[/BOX]

**TYPICAL ENGAGEMENT PHASES**

**Phase 1: Foundation** (Week 1-2)
- Ground Plex deployment on {{customer_name}} OpenShift infrastructure
- Connectivity validation to SAP, Oracle DW, Teamcenter PLM, and MES systems
- RBAC configuration and SSO integration with {{customer_name}} identity provider
- Monitoring and alerting configuration

**Phase 2: Pilot Migration** (Week 3-6)
- Select 3-5 representative Informatica mappings for conversion pilot
- Automated conversion using SnapLogic's Informatica migration tools
- Manual refinement and optimization of converted pipelines
- Performance testing and validation against Informatica baselines

**Phase 3: Team Enablement** (Week 4-8)
- Technical training: SnapLogic Designer, Snap configuration, expression language, error handling
- Best practices workshop: pipeline patterns, reusable assets, monitoring strategies
- Citizen Integrator enablement: SnapGPT-assisted pipeline generation for business analysts

**Phase 4: Production Migration** (Week 7-12)
- Remaining Informatica mapping conversion (automated + manual)
- User acceptance testing and production validation
- Cutover planning and execution support
- Hypercare period with SnapLogic PS on-site or remote support

**POST-IMPLEMENTATION SUPPORT**

SnapLogic offers managed services for ongoing operational support including:
- Pipeline monitoring and incident response
- Performance optimization and scaling guidance
- New use case development and expansion
- Quarterly business reviews and roadmap planning
